name: Differentiable Transient Rendering
aliases: Generalized transport theorem for transient rendering
definition: A technique to compute derivatives of the transient path integral with respect to scene parameters. Unlike steady-state formulations where scattering events are independent, transient rendering accounts for the total time of flight $\text{tof}(\bar{\mathbf{x}})$, making scattering events dependent. It uses the generalized transport theorem on a higher-dimensional manifold.
summary: Differentiable Transient Rendering computes gradients for time-resolved light transport by coupling scattering events via time of flight, unlike steady-state methods.
